purpose: Bounded paired RGB/depth/semantic geometry pilot for warehouse goods segmentation
synthetic_image_convention: pinhole_zero_distortion; independent of unknown real image convention
scene_budget: One aisle, fixed shelves and lighting, three controlled goods scenarios

scenarios.name: clear_aisle
scenarios.scenario_intent: No added goods in the central aisle

scenarios.name: partial_blockage
scenarios.scenario_intent: Goods moved partly into the aisle; operational blockage not safety-certified

scenarios.name: wide_blockage
scenarios.scenario_intent: Wide goods footprint across the aisle; operational blockage not safety-certified

exposure_basis: Pilot appearance review against training-only brightness distributions; not sensor photometric calibration
